text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for allowing me
to rest the other day.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Aside from school assignments, I was also able to study languages, making for a truly productive rest day.
choice_data_list: ...You were really able to get some rest, right?
...You really managed to get some proper rest, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I believe I've had plenty of rest, both physically and mentally.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Starting today,
I once again request your candid and unreserved guidance.
